title: File count message
statement:
Give a message that says how many files were found.

The number is in `count`. When `count` is 1, give `"1 file"`. For any other number, give the number, a space and `files`, for example `"3 files"` or `"0 files"`.
reference: if .count == 1 then "1 file" else "\(.count) files" end
